scripts.demo:game: bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && bun run demo:game:start
scripts.test:tsan: bash scripts/tsan-prep.sh && zig build test -Dsanitize=thread --summary all --error-style minimal; tsan_exit=$?; bash scripts/tsan-prep.sh --restore; exit $tsan_exit
scripts.lint: zsort check . --ban-prefix ./ --ban-prefix src/ && zig fmt --check src && zlint --deny-warnings && zwanzig --format text src && zig build check --summary all
scripts.lint:fix: zsort fix . --ban-prefix ./ --ban-prefix src/ && zig fmt src
